change.intent: Deploy the hosted approval and Word document export repair to the production surfaces that execute the changed code.
inScope: Kestrel One Web approval classification, retry handling, profile, registry, and durable turn changes
Kestrel One turn-worker shared tool catalog and Word document export
Existing workspace preview publication lifecycle used by Word export
protected: Existing database schema and durable interaction fields
Existing Preview Edge routing and publication authority
Existing worker production defaults and secrets

readinessReason: Current validation passes and the changed code maps to two production delivery targets: Vercel one and the Fly turn-worker image. No schema, configuration, Preview Edge, control-worker, RunPod, or tenant-runtime change is present.

directImpacts.effect: Deploy approval recording, approval retry semantics, hosted tool profile/registry, and durable turn failure handling.
Publish and roll out the worker image because it executes the changed durable turn processor and shared tool catalog, including Word export.
Reuse the existing Preview Edge route and lifecycle; no Preview Edge deployment is required.

indirectImpacts.effect: The normal Web deployment runs its existing ordered migration command, but this repair introduces no migration or backfill.
The worker-health API remains backward-compatible and retains its production default, so control-worker and RunPod-worker rollouts are not required.

unknowns: The production Vercel deployment ID is not known locally.
The exact in-scope turn-worker Machine IDs and current provider image records require operator inspection.
Live provider, Fly, and production configuration readiness has not been verified in this analysis.
requiredValidation: Promote the protected production branch and verify the one Vercel build and migration
Publish the turn-worker image with the existing production image smoke
Run the turn-worker disposable canary required by its rollout procedure
Update and verify each exact turn-worker Fly Machine
Run a hosted approval retry/resume smoke and a Build-mode .docx download smoke

contextPack.objective: Release the repair to Web and durable turn execution while preserving existing preview, storage, and production delivery boundaries.
interfaces: Fly turn-worker image and exact Machine update
runtimeConstraints: Deploy Web before the turn-worker image when shared durable-turn behavior changes.
Update one exact Fly Machine at a time and preserve its prior started/stopped state.
Do not activate staged secrets or change provider configuration as part of this release.
No database migration is expected from this diff.
allowedActions: Promote the reviewed code through the protected production branch.
Publish and manually roll out the turn-worker image using the existing runbook.
Run the required hosted approval and Word export smoke checks.
prohibitedActions: Do not deploy Preview Edge, control-worker, managed RunPod-worker, or tenant runtime without separate evidence.
Do not add a production-push workflow or web-triggered deployment path.
Do not perform schema changes, secret rotation, or broad fleet updates under this repair.
